en: A black‑and‑white rural landscape view showing several low farm or institutional buildings clustered together on a flat plain, surrounded by open fields and grassland under a wide sky. The scene appears to be taken from a distance, with wildflowers or tall grasses in the foreground and a sparsely populated horizon in the background. In the upper left corner, faint printed text is visible.
